text.p: Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa announced a cabinet shuffle on Monday, naming new ministers of privatisation, the interior, agriculture and construction.

Matesa said the current privatisation minister, Ivan Penic, would replace Ivan Jarnjak as interior minister. Jarnjak had been named head of the National Security Office under President Franjo Tudjman.
The privatisation ministry will be taken over by Milan Kovac who currently heads the state privatisation agency, which manages government stakes in partly-privatised companies.
Businessman Zlatko Dominkovic becomes agriculture minister, replacing Matej Jankovic. Matesa did not say whether Jankovic would get a new post.

Matesa also named Marko Sirac, director of the state water board, as a long-awaited successor to construction minister Marina Matulovic-Dropulic. She has also served as mayor of the capital Zagreb for over a year.
